knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A fixed route makes it less likely that a surface is missed.
Persistent staining is recorded as a limitation. Unapproved products and sterility claims are not used.
The privacy policy requires excluding people and personal items.
The handover without overpromising section says to explain the outcome without promising sterilisation or infection-free conditions.

practicalCriteria: Inspects a seeded mock bathroom along the fixed route and identifies at least seven of eight defects.
Classifies at least one limitation correctly.
passRule: At least seven of eight defects identified, limitations classified correctly, and a privacy-safe handover note produced. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Unapproved stronger chemical proposed for a limitation
Photograph includes a person or personal documents
